 Myntra Beauty adds Korean skincare brand Anua to portfolio
 The brand’s products are organised around two key ranges: Heartleaf, focused on soothing sensitive and reactive skin, and Peach & Rice, aimed at nourishment and brightening. The collection also includes targeted skincare products addressing concerns such as dark spots, pores, texture and dullness.

 Myntra Beauty has launched South Korean skincare brand Anua in India, adding 16 stock-keeping units (SKUs) across serums, face washes and cleansers, and facial sunscreens to its beauty portfolio. The launch expands the platform’s Korean beauty offering, which includes around 100 K-beauty brands.
The Anua range includes products such as Heartleaf Cleansing Oil and Azelaic Acid 10 Hyaluron Redness Soothing Serum with Cica. Its portfolio focuses on skincare concerns including sensitivity, redness, uneven skin tone, hydration, blemishes and barrier support, with formulations featuring ingredients such as heartleaf, niacinamide, azelaic acid, hyaluronic acid and retinol.
 Advt 
 The brand’s products are organised around two key ranges: Heartleaf, focused on soothing sensitive and reactive skin, and Peach & Rice, aimed at nourishment and brightening. The collection also includes targeted skincare products addressing concerns such as dark spots, pores, texture and dullness.
The launch follows Myntra Beauty’s recent additions of Korean beauty brands Frankly and Seapuri. Anua’s products will be available through Myntra’s platform, where the company uses routine-based search and visual discovery features to help customers find products based on their skincare needs.
 The launch also adds to Myntra’s international beauty portfolio, which spans more than 360 global brands and over 20,000 styles, according to the company. Anua said the partnership would expand access to its skincare range among Indian consumers.
